replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body: They don't at all. This was my fault entirely. I was testing new foliage and radically overdid the detail polycount. Off screen there are also 2,400 infantry which are nuking my CPU. Again, being fixed lol.

replies.author: Overwatcher_Leo
replies.body: Add a profiling step to your test suite and make sure the bot tests new features or reworks for their performance impact. This way, the bot can see such bottlenecks before you playtest it.

replies.author: Significant-Dog-8166
replies.body:
AI is lazy by default and prioritizes speed of release over quality.   Unless you know about LOD systems and force AI to make and set them up, chances are your AI system will decide to skip that entire topic and opt for maximum quality at all times at all view distances.

This alone is what will keep GTA 6 from being cloned in any way except a full decompile.  The optimization and LOD system that went into GTA 5 is insane.
